name: VAGST return (form VAGST 001)
legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, Value Added Goods and Services Tax Return (Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2015), filed for a GST period of two months (s. 29): fifteen numbered items, of which boxes 1 and 2 are the registration number and the name, boxes 3 to 8 the sales and the VAGST collected, boxes 9 to 12 the purchases and the VAGST paid, and boxes 13 to 15 the calculation. The form is VAGST-inclusive: boxes 3, 5 and 9 are totals here (exclusive base plus VAGST) and the exclusive figures sit in boxes 5a and 9a. Box 15 is signed: negative is the credit. The pack declares the bimonth anchored on January–February (Category B, periods ending in February, April, June…); Category A periods (ending in January, March, May…) are a gap of the core, see the README.

deadline.legal_reference: Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2015, s. 41(1) — the return is filed within 15 working days after the end of the GST period, and s. 42(1) makes the net GST payable by the same date; s. 41(2) lets the Commissioner set an alternative date for a non-profit body or a particular case. The date is a count of working days and depends on public holidays, so no day of the month is declared: the Ministry's notice for March 2025 gives Tuesday 22 April 2025 for the Category 'A' period February–March.

boxes.name: Box 3 — Total sales/income inclusive of VAGST
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 3 — total sales and income inclusive of VAGST (including imported services consumed by exempt bodies), zero-rated supplies included. Here boxes 4 and 5 added.

boxes.name: Box 4 — Zero-rated supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 4 — the amount of zero-rated supplies, if any; included in box 3.

boxes.name: Box 5 — Taxable sales (box 3 less box 4), VAGST included
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 5 — subtract box 4 from box 3. Here the exclusive base of box 5a plus the VAGST of box 6.

boxes.name: Box 5a — Taxable sales, VAGST excluded
boxes.legal_reference: Not a box of the form: the exclusive value of the taxable sales of box 5, which the engine posts and from which box 5 is rebuilt.

boxes.name: Box 6 — VAGST collected by you (box 5 divided by 7.66667)
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 6 — divide box 5 by 7.66667, the tax fraction of 15 % (15/115). Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2015, s. 8(3)(b).

boxes.name: Box 7 — Tax adjustments (VAGST amount only), sales side
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 7 — tax adjustments, VAGST amount only (adjustment events and bad debts). Declared and empty: a decision of the preparer, no tax code posts to it.

boxes.name: Box 8 — Total output tax (boxes 6 and 7)
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 8 — add box 6 and 7: total output tax.

boxes.name: Box 9 — Total taxable purchases/expenses received, VAGST included
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 9 — total taxable purchases and expenses received including VAGST, excluding tax paid to the Customs Service. Here the exclusive base of box 9a plus the VAGST of box 10.

boxes.name: Box 9a — Local purchases carrying creditable VAGST, VAGST excluded
boxes.legal_reference: Not a box of the form: the exclusive value of the local purchases whose VAGST is posted to box 10.

boxes.name: Box 10 — VAGST paid by you (box 9 divided by 7.66667)
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 10 — divide box 9 by 7.66667. Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2015, s. 26(1).

boxes.name: Box 11 — Tax adjustments (VAGST amount only), including VAGST paid to Customs
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 11 — tax adjustments, VAGST amount only, including VAGST paid to the Customs Service. The VAGST of imported goods is posted here.

boxes.name: Box 11a — Imports, customs value
boxes.legal_reference: Not a box of the form: the value of the imported goods whose VAGST is posted to box 11; the form asks for the VAGST only.

boxes.name: Box 12 — Total input tax (boxes 10 and 11)
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 12 — add box 10 and 11: total input tax.

boxes.name: Box 13 — VAGST to pay (positive) or VAGST credit (negative), box 8 less box 12
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 13 — the difference between box 8 and box 12: if box 12 is greater, the difference is the VAGST credit; if box 8 is greater, it is the VAGST to pay. Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2015, s. 30, net GST payable (A+B)-C. Signed: negative is the credit.

boxes.name: Box 14 — Credit brought forward from previous months
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 14 — credit brought forward, entered as a positive amount. Declared and empty: it is the preparer's, from the previous return (s. 31, refunds).

boxes.name: Box 15 — VAGST to pay (positive) or total VAGST credit (negative)
boxes.legal_reference: Form VAGST 001, box 15 — if box 13 is VAGST to pay, subtract the credit brought forward of box 14; if box 13 is a credit, add box 14 to it. Signed: negative is the credit; the net GST is payable by the filing date (s. 42(1)).
